AS-REV-01 High scripts/session-4885d641/originate_desk.py (L249, L298-300, L333-341, L354-356, L426-440) & data/session-{4885d641,509d544b,6846f1ab}/desk.json Synthetic Probability Override Clamping `originate_desk.py` accepts a hardcoded `pred_override['p_target']` dictionary that overwrites closed-form handicap (`p_cover`), total (`p_over`), derivative (`d_p`), and outright (`p_a`) probabilities into a narrow `[0.700, 0.704]` band (-233 to -238 American) so picks clear a 70% threshold while staying above -250. Both `session-509d544b` and `session-6846f1ab` inherited those `ag_*` rows verbatim. Zero `p_target` overrides anywhere in `scripts/session-543dca7d/math_models.py` or `originate.py`; every market probability is pure closed-form output. Manual Review Official Link ↗
